title: Tytuvėnai Monastery First Livestock Barn

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified open elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Lithuanian GRPK registry footprint and individual Cultural Heritage Register location
mapIdentity.scope: The northern run is independently identified by the heritage locator. The mapped outer polygon is split at the inset corner between the two connected livestock barns.

note: A long, single-storey brick and fieldstone barn with a gable roof, arched masonry entrances and small rectangular openings.
